import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
taiwan = ee.Geometry.Polygon([
    [[119.5, 21.9], [122.0, 21.9], [122.0, 25.3], [119.5, 25.3], [119.5, 21.9]]
])

period1_start = '2020-02-10'
period1_end = '2020-02-26'
period2_start = '2020-04-20'
period2_end = '2020-05-13'

# 2. Data Acquisition
collection_id = 'COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2'
band = 'tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density'

def mask_no2(image):
    qa = image.select('qa_value')
    mask = qa.gte(0.75)
    return image.updateMask(mask)

col1 = ee.ImageCollection(collection_id).filterDate(period1_start, period1_end).filterBounds(taiwan).map(mask_no2)
col2 = ee.ImageCollection(collection_id).filterDate(period2_start, period2_end).filterBounds(taiwan).map(mask_no2)

size1 = col1.size().getInfo()
size2 = col2.size().getInfo()

print(f"Period 1 (Feb 10-25): {size1} images")
print(f"Period 2 (Apr 20-May 12): {size2} images")

if size1 == 0 or size2 == 0:
    print("Empty collection for one or both periods.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # 3. Processing
    img1 = col1.mean().select(band)
    img2 = col2.mean().select(band)
    
    # Check pixel counts
    count1 = img1.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=taiwan,
        scale=5000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get(band).getInfo()
    
    count2 = img2.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=taiwan,
        scale=5000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get(band).getInfo()
    
    print(f"Valid pixels - Period 1: {count1}, Period 2: {count2}")
    
    if count1 == 0 or count2 == 0:
        print("No valid pixels after masking.")
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    else:
        # 4. Calculation
        mean1 = img1.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
            geometry=taiwan,
            scale=5000,
            maxPixels=1e9
        ).get(band).getInfo()
        
        mean2 = img2.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
            geometry=taiwan,
            scale=5000,
            maxPixels=1e9
        ).get(band).getInfo()
        
        print(f"Mean NO2 - Feb 10-25: {mean1}")
        print(f"Mean NO2 - Apr 20-May 12: {mean2}")
        
        # 5. Validation & Final Answer
        if mean1 is None or mean2 is None:
            print("Calculation failure: None values.")
            print("<answer>C3</answer>")
        else:
            print(f"Difference (Apr-May minus Feb): {mean2 - mean1:.6e}")
            if mean2 > mean1:
                print("<answer>A</answer>")
            else:
                print("<answer>B</answer>")
